summary.prose: Building this Story is a four-task change: t1 (already built) added the status-independent artifact scanner; t2 registers its daemon-side IPC handler in every completeness table the daemon enforces; t3 adds the client-side forward and re-points insrc_present at it; t4 extends the two affected test files and confirms the daemon's own four completeness suites pass. Nothing outside pending.ts, handler-runtime.ts, repo-call-audit.ts, method-class.ts, daemon-stream.ts, server.ts and their four test files changes.

tasks.title: Add resolveOpenableArtifacts to src/workflow/pending.ts
tasks.summary: Add the new exported function resolveOpenableArtifacts(repoPath): readonly {artifactId, mdPath}[], copying listPendingArtifacts' file-scan loop but keeping only the kind-filter (PENDING_KINDS) and the malformed-JSON try/catch guards; drop the approvalStateOf/AMD-status pending check and the BUILD/CR-sibling check entirely. Derive mdPath via the existing, already-exported deriveMdPath. (Already implemented and validated; unchanged by this revision.)
acceptanceChecks: resolveOpenableArtifacts returns an entry for a PENDING_KINDS artifact file regardless of its lifecycle status (draft, approved or rejected)
resolveOpenableArtifacts returns an entry for a non-standalone BUILD with no CR sibling
resolveOpenableArtifacts excludes a non-PENDING_KINDS file
resolveOpenableArtifacts skips a malformed JSON file (logged) without dropping the rest of the scan
listPendingArtifacts itself is untouched -- no change to its own exported behavior

tests.name: resolveOpenableArtifacts returns a draft (never-decided) artifact
resolveOpenableArtifacts returns an approved artifact
resolveOpenableArtifacts returns a rejected artifact
resolveOpenableArtifacts returns a non-standalone BUILD with no CR sibling
resolveOpenableArtifacts excludes a non-PENDING_KINDS file (e.g. an EPIC/STORY/TASK record)
resolveOpenableArtifacts skips a malformed JSON file without dropping the rest of the scan

tasks.title: Register the daemon-side 'workflow.openable' handler and every completeness registry it requires
tasks.summary: Add handleWorkflowOpenable (plus WorkflowOpenableResult/WorkflowOpenableError interfaces) to src/workflow/pending.ts, mirroring handleWorkflowPending's repo-resolution rule exactly. Register a new 'workflow.openable' entry in src/daemon/handler-runtime.ts's method table (mirroring 'workflow.pending'). Add the matching entry to src/daemon/repo-call-audit.ts's RPC_AUDIT (kind: 'read-only'), to src/daemon/threads/method-class.ts's TABLE (['workflow.openable', 'session', false]), and to src/daemon/__tests__/handler-runtime.test.ts's ADDED_RPC array. These five edits must land together: the daemon's own completeness tests (repo-call-audit.test.ts, method-class.test.ts, handler-runtime.test.ts) fail if any one is missing.
acceptanceChecks: handleWorkflowOpenable returns { artifacts } from a fixture repo via resolveOpenableArtifacts
handleWorkflowOpenable returns { error } when repo cannot be resolved from params or repoEnv
repo-call-audit.test.ts passes with 'workflow.openable' present in RPC_AUDIT
method-class.test.ts's coverage test passes with 'workflow.openable' present in the TABLE
handler-runtime.test.ts passes with 'workflow.openable' present in ADDED_RPC
repo-call-table.test.ts passes with no separate edit (workflow.openable's read-only RPC_AUDIT kind satisfies it)

tests.name: handleWorkflowOpenable returns { artifacts } from a fixture repo via resolveOpenableArtifacts
handleWorkflowOpenable returns { error } when repo cannot be resolved from params or repoEnv
repo-call-audit.test.ts: every method of the handler registry has an audit entry, now including workflow.openable
method-class.test.ts: the method set equals the keys of the constructed rpcHandlers and streamHandlers, now including workflow.openable
handler-runtime.test.ts: RECORDED_RPC + ADDED_RPC equals the registered method set, now including workflow.openable in ADDED_RPC

tasks.title: Add openableWorkflow and wire handleInsrcPresent to it
tasks.summary: Add openableWorkflow to src/mcp/daemon-stream.ts, mirroring pendingWorkflow's unaryRpc forward but naming 'workflow.openable'. Change handleInsrcPresent in src/mcp/server.ts to call openableWorkflow instead of pendingWorkflow; remove the now-unused pendingWorkflow import from server.ts if nothing else there needs it. Keep namesPending and the ambiguity-filter unchanged.

handleInsrcPresent presents the same BUILD by its repo-relative doc path
handleInsrcPresent presents an already-approved or already-rejected artifact by name
handleInsrcPresent still reports notPending for a name matching zero artifacts
handleInsrcPresent still reports notPending for a bare filename matching more than one document
handleInsrcPresent still answers a daemon error or an unreachable daemon as an explicit error
handleInsrcPresent's external response shape stays { presented: string[], notPending: string[] }

tasks.title: Add/extend tests for handleWorkflowOpenable and handleInsrcPresent, and confirm every completeness suite passes
tasks.summary: Extend src/workflow/__tests__/pending.test.ts with handleWorkflowOpenable unit tests. Update src/mcp/__tests__/present-dispatch.test.ts: every fakeDaemon() assertion of the called method name changes from 'workflow.pending' to 'workflow.openable', and every fixture object is trimmed to the minimal {artifactId, mdPath} shape. Run repo-call-audit.test.ts, method-class.test.ts, handler-runtime.test.ts and repo-call-table.test.ts to confirm their completeness checks pass with no further edits.

Every criterionId in testStrategy.acceptanceMapping (ac1-ac4) has its provingTests present and passing
No existing test in pending.test.ts, present-dispatch.test.ts or the three completeness-test files needs to change beyond the planned method-name/fixture-shape updates

all t1/t2/t3 proving tests exist as real, passing test cases across pending.test.ts, present-dispatch.test.ts and the three completeness-test files
